title: Ang mga Anak Dalita
summary: "Ang mga Anak Dalita" by Patricio Mariano is a Tagalog-language novel published in 1911. Written in poetic form, this political work explores the exploitation of Manila's working class during the American colonial era. When a poor woman named Ata faces assault from her factory owner, a chain of events unfolds involving her daughter Teta and lover Pedro.
